question_vi: CODEOWNERS file hoạt động như thế nào? Cách dùng để enforce review chính xác trong team lớn?
question_en: How does the CODEOWNERS file work? How do you use it to enforce precise reviews in a large team?
answer_vi:
CODEOWNERS (`/.github/CODEOWNERS`) định nghĩa ai là owner của file/directory — GitHub tự động add họ làm required reviewers khi PR sửa các file đó.

**Format:**
```
# Syntax: pattern  @user-or-team
*                   @default-reviewer          # catch-all
/src/auth/          @security-team             # auth code
/src/payments/      @payments-team @cto        # payments: 2 owners
*.sql               @dba-team                  # all SQL files
/docs/              @tech-writer               # documentation
/.github/           @devops-team               # CI/CD configs
/package.json       @lead-dev                  # dependency changes
```

**Rules:**
- Patterns match như `.gitignore` — last matching rule wins
- Cần enable "Require review from Code Owners" trong branch protection
- Team owners: `@org/team-name` (không phải individual)

**Lưu ý:**
- Quá nhiều owners → bottleneck (mọi PR cần 5 người approve)
- Không review CODEOWNERS định kỳ → departed employees vẫn là required reviewers
- Forgetting catch-all `*` rule → new files có thể không có owner

**Best practice:** ít owners per path, dùng teams thay vì individuals, review CODEOWNERS mỗi quarter
answer_en:
CODEOWNERS (`/.github/CODEOWNERS`) defines who owns files/directories — GitHub automatically adds them as required reviewers when a PR touches those files.

**Format:**
```
# Syntax: pattern  @user-or-team
*                   @default-reviewer          # catch-all
/src/auth/          @security-team             # auth code
/src/payments/      @payments-team @cto        # payments: 2 owners
*.sql               @dba-team                  # all SQL files
/docs/              @tech-writer               # documentation
/.github/           @devops-team               # CI/CD configs
/package.json       @lead-dev                  # dependency changes
```

**Rules:**
- Patterns match like `.gitignore` — last matching rule wins
- Need to enable "Require review from Code Owners" in branch protection
- Team owners: `@org/team-name` (not individuals)

**Notes:**
- Too many owners → bottleneck (every PR needs 5 approvals)
- Not reviewing CODEOWNERS regularly → departed employees remain required reviewers
- Forgetting a catch-all `*` rule → new files may have no owner

**Best practice:** few owners per path, use teams instead of individuals, review CODEOWNERS every quarter
